vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: dlazy-banana2
Version: 1.0.4

The dlazy-banana2 skill is a legitimate wrapper for the @dlazy/cli tool, facilitating image generation and editing. It transparently discloses its data privacy practices, including the upload of local files to oss.dlazy.com and the storage of API keys in ~/.dlazy/config.json. The instructions provided in SKILL.md are well-aligned with the stated purpose, focusing on command usage and standard error handling for authentication and billing issues.

llm.summary: The skill's requirements and instructions are consistent with a CLI for an image-generation service; it asks for npm/npx and an API key and documents uploading local files to dlazy's servers, which matches its stated purpose.

dimensions.detail: Name/description (Nano Banana 2.0 image gen/edit) match the requested binaries (npm, npx) and the CLI metadata (npm package @dlazy/cli). Declared network hosts (dlazy.com, api.dlazy.com, oss.dlazy.com) are consistent with an image-hosting/generation service.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: SKILL.md instructions are narrowly focused on running the dlazy CLI, provide exact command flags, and explicitly state that prompts and local files are uploaded to dlazy. The instructions warn not to upload secrets. There is no instruction to access unrelated files, credentials, or system state.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The registry lists no formal install spec, but SKILL.md metadata includes an explicit npm install -g @dlazy/cli@1.0.6 and an npx alternative. Installing from the public npm registry is expected for a CLI but carries the normal moderate risk of third-party packages; the skill pins a specific version which is good practice.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: No unrelated environment variables or credentials are requested. The skill documents using an API key (persisted in plaintext at ~/.dlazy/config.json or passed via DLAZY_API_KEY). Plaintext local storage is expected but is a privacy consideration the user should weigh.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: Skill is not always-enabled, is user-invocable, and does not request elevated privileges or modifications to other skills. It only describes storing the service API key in its own config path, which is normal for a CLI tool.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill appears to be what it says: a CLI wrapper for dLazy's image-generation service. Before installing or using it: (1) review the GitHub repo and npm package linked in the SKILL.md to inspect the code; (2) prefer using npx for ephemeral execution instead of a global npm install if you want less persistence; (3) do not upload files that contain secrets or PII—local images passed to the CLI are uploaded to oss.dlazy.com; (4) note the API key may be stored in plaintext at ~/.dlazy/config.json if you use dlazy auth set—use an ephemeral DLAZY_API_KEY environment variable if you prefer not to persist the key, and rotate/revoke keys as needed; (5) check dlazy.com privacy and billing settings (the skill will surface insufficient-balance errors).
